It covers social engineering (vishing, OAuth token abuse) against Salesforce, Salesloft and Drift, a 2025 timeline, ATT&CK-mapped techniques, an extortion portal listing claimed breach volumes, and group aliases. The report hedges several links between the groups.

a9b672e6b7b7b4fbb6444257fc169dff689b1dcb.summary: This is an archived index page of IT news headlines dated late March to early April 2026, not a threat report. Its items cover telecoms, cloud, AI, public-sector IT and procurement. The only security-related headlines are a note that the NCSC warned high-risk individuals about phishing on encrypted messaging apps, and a report that Lloyds admitted a coding fault exposed customer transactions. The page itself gives no detail on either, so no facts are recorded.

audit.note: summary: It says the NCSC and Lloyds items are the only security-related headlines. The page also carries other security items: the SAP/Uptycs threat-data piece
